name: rename-struct-overlay-to-type-overlay
title: Rename Struct Overlay to Type Overlay
description: Rename the umbrella concept from 'Struct Overlay' to 'Type Overlay' since it handles struct, bit-field and enum definitions plus their instances: user-facing labels (feature name, sidebar tab, section headers), core/webview TypeScript identifiers (StructDef->TypeDef, StructPin->TypeInstance, etc.), and directory/file names (core/struct -> core/overlay, structPanel -> overlayPanel). The kind values struct/bitfield/enum stay; the persisted contract (.hexscope/structs.json, structPins, schemas/structs.schema.json) is frozen: no migration and no schemaVersion bump.
creator: deviousprophet
